column1: # The 16 DRTs on 23 vertices at UNRESTRICTED MARGIN, as Jean Zay's own
# aggregate.sh reported them on 2026-09-22 after the last six chunks were
# finished on the laptop.  Transcribed from that run, not recomputed here.
# `capped` is 0 on every row BY CONSTRUCTION, not by separate observation:
# aggregate.sh reports UNSAT only when a host's markers tile [0,8031) exactly
# AND nothing is capped, so an UNSAT here already carries both facts.  The
# column exists because verdict_ledger.py keys on it and refuses a rollup
# without it -- it must never be filled in from anywhere but that rule.
# d003 and d009 are NOT here; they ran on the laptop and are in
# drt23_maj/drt23_maj.tsv.  Together with Paley(23) that is 19 of 19
